selection.role: Selected row background; pair with ink

border.role: Control outlines; avoid framing every content row

focus.role: Keyboard owner outline; also show a text cue

danger.role: Failure or destructive confirmation; never ordinary selection

ready.role: Ready for input; the only green liveness indicator

limit-reached.role: Usage limit; wait or choose an eligible account

font-ui.role: Web labels; TUI inherits the user's terminal font

font-mono.role: Code, paths, terminal samples; TUI inherits terminal font

type-body.role: 14px controls and body; one terminal row

type-title.role: 16px section title; bold one-row TUI heading

type-display.role: 20px dialog or empty-state title; bold TUI heading

line-height.role: Web prose rhythm; terminal uses one row

weight-strong.role: Selected names and headings; TUI bold true

space-3.role: Compact row inset; one horizontal cell

space-6.role: Section gap; one vertical blank row

space-8.role: Major section gap; two vertical blank rows

radius-none.role: Terminal chrome and structural dividers; square border

radius-control.role: Inputs and buttons; square TUI border

focus-width.role: Web focus ring; one-cell TUI frame plus keyboard label

target-min.role: Web touch target; one terminal row

motion-transition.role: Only user-caused web disclosure; TUI changes immediately
